behavior: A Pi session's Unread is reviewable with the same R key, and MarkReviewed carries the Pi ReadyObservation verbatim.
failure_caught: A provider-specific gate treating Pi as unsupported so R does nothing, or a different observation acknowledged.
criticality_reason: Bounded: only Pi's review path is affected, and the user can still answer the agent (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/dashboard/unread.rs:88-95).
signal_reason: Asserts Redraw plus the exact MarkReviewed session and expected observation for Pi (tests/tui/unread.rs:205-223).
uniqueness_reason: A provider cell of the review-identity contract already asserted for Claude/Codex; the Pi identity is the distinction (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/dashboard/unread.rs:88-95).
fidelity_reason: Real unread identity, key dispatch and outbox with a Pi snapshot (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/dashboard/unread.rs:88-95).
cost_drivers: One render and one key dispatch

behavior: With two Input requests open alongside a Ready Unread, R still sends MarkReviewed with the presented Ready; closing one request and then both leaves the review target unchanged.
failure_caught: An open Input request suppressing or replacing the Unread, so answering an approval is mistaken for reviewing, or a closed request clearing the review target.
criticality_reason: Input and Unread are independent lanes; conflating them would clear a notification the user has not seen or lose it on answer (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/dashboard/unread.rs:1-15).
signal_reason: Three states (two open, one closed, all closed) each asserting the exact MarkReviewed payload (tests/tui/unread.rs:226-315).
uniqueness_reason: The input-request lane independence is unique; other unread tests have no open requests (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/dashboard/unread.rs:30-75).
fidelity_reason: Real input-request observation, review target and request dispatch (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/dashboard/unread.rs:30-115).
recommendation_reason: Only test of Unread identity under open/closed Input requests.
cost_drivers: Three published sessions, three renders and three key dispatches

behavior: A paste before the Unread is drawn reviews nothing; after drawing, the first paste sends exactly one MarkReviewed and a second paste sends none.
failure_caught: Reviewing an Unread the user never saw, or repeating the acknowledgement for every keystroke of one reply.
criticality_reason: Reviewing unseen responses loses the notification, and repeated acknowledgements churn durable state (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/dashboard/unread.rs:96-105).
signal_reason: Asserts the empty outbox before drawing, the exact MarkReviewed once after drawing, and the empty outbox on the second paste (tests/tui/unread.rs:318-354).
uniqueness_reason: Drawn-once paste semantics are unique; the R key path is covered by the review-identity test (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/dashboard/unread.rs:96-105).
fidelity_reason: Real paste dispatch, drawn-presented tracking and outbox (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/dashboard/unread.rs:96-105).
recommendation_reason: Only test of the once-per-displayed-observation paste rule.
cost_drivers: Two paste dispatches and two renders
